items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 13 at 6:15PM EST until November 15 at 12:00AM EST by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Northwest winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and
seas 4 to 7 ft expected.

* WHERE...The coastal waters from Duck to Ocracoke Inlet.

* WHEN...From midnight tonight to midnight EST Saturday night.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
